findings: Next.js 16: dynamic route params are Promises; await them (`const { slug } = await params`) instead of destructuring synchronously.
With `output: 'export'`, every dynamic route needs generateStaticParams so pages exist as static HTML; use notFound() for unknown slugs.
Import Geist and other fonts in the root layout.tsx and expose CSS variables; avoid runtime font loading flicker.
Use pure-SVG or CSS timeline/diagram nodes rather than canvas-heavy libraries for iOS Safari compatibility.
Exact asset filename casing matters on case-sensitive hosts/CDNs even when local Windows builds pass.
Treat the portfolio as a product: a reader journey (hero -> proof -> case study -> contact) beats a feature list; keep visual design simple and consistent.
